content: The model was trained via gradient backpropagation with the cross-entropy loss function of answer span prediction and answerable classification, optimized by Adam algorithm BIBREF26 with initial learning rate of INLINEFORM0 . Pre-trained GloVe BIBREF3 embeddings (size INLINEFORM1 ) were used. We re-shuffled training samples at each epoch (batch size INLINEFORM2 ). Out-of-vocabulary words ( INLINEFORM3 ) were replaced with a fixed random vector. L2 regularization and dropout (rate INLINEFORM4 ) were used to alleviate overfitting BIBREF27 .
